sources: Google Merchant Center via authorized read-only connection
limitations: Website sitemap is a published URL inventory, not a backend inventory or confirmation of purchasability.
No CS-Cart backend API export, cost prices, margins, stock quantities or full specifications were available.
Prices and availability are available only for Merchant records and are a point-in-time snapshot. IN_STOCK does not prove physical Bratislava stock.
Titles from image sitemap are image metadata, not verified product H1 headings. url_label is a mechanical URL label, not an authoritative product name.
58 nonempty brands are represented in Merchant; this is not the complete website brand count.
All listed public product URLs were exported; the individual 14716 pages were not crawled.
Missing from Google does not mean missing from assortment or erroneous omission.
